'''2001 Swedish National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in Sweden in 2001. [[Martin Akesson]] won it.<ref name="dt-16063">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16063 Steken (the steak)], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 20 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16063/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16063/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 20 May)
* '''Site:''' Sweden
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Akesson]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.
